    def thousandSeparator(self, n: int) -> str:
        s = str(n)
        chunks = []
        i = len(s)
        while i > 0:
            chunks.append(s[max(0, i-3):i])
            i -= 3
        chunks = chunks[::-1]
        result = ".".join(chunks)
        return result"}
